serving_workloads.title: MPK-Comparable Offline Decode

paper_source.notes: The MPK paper uses offline batched inference, fixed prompt length 64, decode length 1024, maximum batch sizes from 1 to 16, and compares MPK with vLLM and SGLang on A100/H100/B200.

model_policy.selection_reason: Qwen3-8B is common to the MPK paper and VDCores paper model sets; smaller Qwen3 models are allowed only for setup and correctness bring-up.

prompt_policy.prompt_text: Give me a short introduction to large language model.
prompt_policy.tokenization_rule: Each backend must record the actual tokenizer, chat template, and token count in raw JSON; prompts are padded or regenerated only in a documented raw artifact.

decode_policy.traffic_mode: offline batched inference without request-arrival variability
decode_policy.generation_mode: deterministic greedy decode unless a baseline cannot expose greedy mode, in which case the raw artifact must document the substitute.

current_blockers: MPK, vLLM, and SGLang runtime packages still need full H200 setup and captured runs.
PTO CUDA does not yet have a serving-equivalent workload for this policy.

serving_workloads.title: MPK Native Qwen3 0.6B Token Bring-Up

paper_source.notes: This is an MPK native torch environment bring-up workload, not the MPK persistent-kernel paper-serving workload.

model_policy.selection_reason: The imported H200 artifact uses Qwen3-0.6B for bounded MPK native setup validation. Full paper comparison remains on Qwen3-8B.

prompt_policy.prompt_text: Give me a short introduction to large language model.
prompt_policy.tokenization_rule: The MPK native demo records the tokenizer-observed prompt length in native-token2.json.

decode_policy.generation_mode: deterministic greedy decode with ignore_eos for bounded bring-up

current_blockers: This workload is MPK native bring-up evidence only; MPK persistent-kernel paper evidence remains blocked.

serving_workloads.title: VDCores-Comparable Offline Decode

paper_source.notes: The VDCores paper evaluates offline decoding of a fixed batch for 64 steps from a 128-token context, batch sizes 1 to 16, and baselines including vLLM, SGLang, Mirage, ThunderKittens variants, and Torch plus ThunderKittens.

model_policy.selection_reason: Qwen3-8B appears in the VDCores and MPK paper model sets. Llama-3.1-8B remains the current VDCores demo path and requires HF_TOKEN.

prompt_policy.prompt_text: Give me a short introduction to large language model.
prompt_policy.tokenization_rule: Each backend must record actual tokenizer, chat template, and token count. VDCores runs must also record the scheduled decode count after KV-block rounding.

decode_policy.generation_mode: deterministic greedy decode with correctness against the baseline framework where available

current_blockers: VDCores extension and model path still need captured H200 run artifacts.
vLLM and SGLang packages are not yet installed for H200 serving capture.
ThunderKittens has imported padded H100 MHA decode-attention tile rows for the policy batch ladder, but not the full Llama/Qwen serving-family sweep.
PTO persistent_device has an imported controlled attention-tile proxy; a full Llama/Qwen serving-family PTO sweep remains absent.
